route_task: SlotSPE / SPE-08 / original design, forward effect and gradient attribution

primary_paper.openreview_read_status: browser challenge; arXiv author paper read successfully

verified_design.output_slot_goal: Reduce slot redundancy, encourage distinct prognostic events and specialization. Redundant inputs do not imply the output slots are intended to be mutually redundant.
verified_design.gate_supervision: Equation 18 explicitly contains fused survival loss plus histology and omics survival losses; each modality MoE decoder supplies the respective single-modal logits.
verified_design.intra_modal_forward: Section 3.2 explicitly uses selected Top-K slots in masked self-attention; inter-modal attention uses all slots.
verified_design.differentiability: B.2 describes hard-forward soft-backward straight-through selection. Hard Top-K alone does not imply that every loss must have no gate gradient.
verified_design.not_explicitly_required: The cited design does not explicitly require pred_keep_slot parameters to receive a direct gradient from the fused survival loss.

verified_source.interpretation: Hard masks participate in fused forward computation; bool conversion removes the direct surrogate gradient to the score predictor. Auxiliary decoder survival gradients remain. No direct fused gradient is not the same as no forward influence.

assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.claim: Changing checkpoint while keeping temperature fixed excludes temperature as a cause.
assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.verdict: Does not follow. Selected mass q depends on scores, temperature and noisy mask jointly; gate_sum=q/(q+1e-8). Conditional occurrence is compatible with a temperature-related numerical mechanism.

assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.claim: Near-zero nonsignificant correlation proves no causality.
assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.verdict: Does not follow. At most no clear monotonic association was detected under that measurement protocol.

assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.claim: cosine about 0.997 proves the information bottleneck is working normally.
assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.verdict: Does not follow. High cosine alone proves neither prediction harm nor successful distinct event compression. The paper explicitly aims to reduce output-slot redundancy.

assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.claim: L3 uniform paired training establishes that gating has no effect.
assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.verdict: Exact receipt and arm contract were not located. A small measured change under one protocol does not establish equivalence; distinguish soft gate removal from hard-mask and auxiliary-loss changes.

assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.claim: Cross-fold C-index SD 0.0618 makes paired changes of 0.01 unmeasurable.
assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.verdict: Cannot infer power this way. Matched-arm inference requires the distribution of within-fold/seed paired differences and their dependence, not an unpaired baseline SD.

assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.claim: Direct fused-loss gate gradient is absent, so the gate does not affect the main readout.
assessment_of_user_quoted_claims.verdict: False as a structural inference. The hard mask is passed to the self-attention branches before fused logits; forward dependence and autograd connectivity are different.

unverified_quoted_new_results: zero collapse in the cited 77-case joint diagnosis on checkpoint4b89dc35
L3 paired training, cosine delta=-0.00078, loss 2.41856 to 2.43769

current_audited_local_gate_result.protocol: fixed-slot 20 draws and full-model RNG 20 draws, 3-epoch BLCA fold0/seed3
current_audited_local_gate_result.interpretation: No gate-sum collapse observed under this protocol; not a global exclusion.

practical_conclusion: Do not present gate collapse as an established patient-level problem. Do not label redundancy harmless or the whole line excluded. Direct fused gate-gradient absence alone is insufficient to classify a bug. Any benefit from connecting it or reducing redundancy remains unestablished.
gaps_reasons: The cited joint-diagnosis and L3 paired-training raw receipts and full arm contracts are unavailable in the reviewed public evidence. No new patient experiment was authorized or run.
next_action_user_inputs: Design-document question is resolved. If the new L3 or correlation claims need acceptance, obtain their exact run receipt and arm definition; do not automatically launch another experiment.
